description: Rename a site you own. Its free address changes to the new name; the old address keeps working by redirecting to the new one, and the old name stays reserved for this site, so it can be switched back. Pages, history, statistics, custom domains, forms, editors and GitHub publishing all carry over. Confirm the new name with the person first.

new_name.description:
The new name: 3 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens (no dots). The site's free
address becomes <new_name>.<sites domain>.

name: rename_site
